report_list: Missed Appointments Not Marked As Missed
observations: Third-reader verified inventory: all 9 original screenshots and all pre-rendered zooms were re-read, every A-vs-B difference was settled on the pixels, and each file was swept for missed elements with a colour scan of the criteria area (nothing beyond the controls listed here was found). COVERAGE: all 9 files are the same two-panel screen in its normal state - no popup, no expanded dropdown, no second view of the same report; each screenshot shows a different report selected (blue radio dot located in each file), so all 9 listed reports are covered exactly once: 1=Appointment List, 2=Missed Appointments Not Marked As Missed, 3=New Patients via Appointments, 4=Lab Report, 5=SmartAssist Report Card, 6=Appointments Confirmed Via Vendors, 7=Appointment Time Stamps, 8=Appointment Detail, 9=Lab Cost Report. TITLE BAR (identical in all 9): 'Appointment Reports' at the left; 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a printer icon at the right. No footer text (only a thin grey window-edge strip below the panels). LEFT PANEL 'SELECT REPORT': 9 radio entries in a two-column grid (5 in the left column, 4 in the right, bottom-right cell empty); 'Missed Appointments Not Marked As Missed' wraps onto two lines; large empty area below - the list is not scrollable or clipped. Casing as displayed: 'New Patients via Appointments' (lower-case via) but 'Appointments Confirmed Via Vendors' (capital Via). A splitter handle (three dots) sits between the two panels. RIGHT PANEL 'REPORT CRITERIA': grey CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon) at the right end of the blue panel bar - same grey look in all 9 files, so it is its normal style, not a disabled state; blue PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and '+ ADD TO MY FAVORITES' buttons sit in a grey action bar pinned to the bottom of the panel. No static instruction / legend text anywhere in the criteria panels. NOT VISIBLE ANYWHERE in this category: the contents of the Office / Office Group / Provider / User / Operatory / Lab / Vendors / Cancellation Reason / Patient Type / Resp. Party Type pickers and the other values of the 'Length' dropdown (only 'Any' is shown); only one state per report was captured, so controls that depend on a radio or checkbox choice (the other five list types of Appointment List, the other Lab Report types, Only AppointNow Appointments ticked, GROUP BY = User, Include Cancelled Appointments ticked) are seen only in their default-state enabled/disabled form. RECURRING DEFAULTS: PRINT FORMAT = PDF (options PDF, Excel) on 8 of 9 reports - none visible on Appointment List; OFFICE/GROUP = Office (options Office, Office Group) with an unlabelled read-only box showing 108 (= OID) + SELECT on all 9; a Provider picker (ALL) on 7 reports (absent on New Patients via Appointments and Appointments Confirmed Via Vendors); User / Lab / Vendors / Operatory / Cancellation Reason pickers = ALL; EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE + EXCLUDE RESP. PARTY TYPE pickers = None on Appointment List (greyed), Missed Appointments Not Marked As Missed, Lab Report and Lab Cost Report; every date box = 11/21/2026 (the capture date, i.e. today) with a calendar icon. SELECT button icons: building (Office, Lab, Vendors, Cancellation Reason), single person (Provider, Operatory), person-plus (User, Exclude Patient Type, Exclude Resp. Party Type). DISABLED-STATE EVIDENCE (pixel colours, not just by eye): disabled SELECT buttons are grey (176,183,190) instead of blue (41,134,220); disabled radio / checkbox labels are grey (161,161,161) instead of black; disabled inputs and dropdowns use the fill 220,223,226 of the read-only picker boxes instead of the 241,241,241 of enabled inputs (calibrated against the other report categories: about 35 dropdowns there use the light fill, the only other grey one is a dependency-gated Fee Schedule dropdown in My Reports). Greyed controls exist only in 1.PNG (Appointment List: both Exclude SELECT buttons, Cancellation Reason SELECT, Operatory SELECT, Length dropdown, Status Missed / Cancelled, Include Off Call List, all four SORT BY radios), 4.PNG (Lab Report: Due Date box) and 8.PNG (Appointment Detail: Both / Appoint Now / Appoint Now API radios, the 'User' option of PAGE BREAK BY, Cancellation Reason SELECT). TWO REPORTS DO NOT FIT THE VIEWPORT: the criteria viewport has a fixed height (482 px between the panel border and the action bar in every file) and no scrollbar is drawn even when the content is taller. (a) Appointment List (1.PNG) was captured scrolled to its bottom end - it is the only screenshot (also compared with the criteria screens of the other report categories) whose content does not start with a 1 px light line followed by a full 25 px header: its first header bar is cut to a 10 px strip without text, so that title is unreadable (it cannot even be told whether the bar carries a title), and no PRINT FORMAT section is visible; unknown whether the report has none or it is hidden above. (b) Appointment Detail (8.PNG) is clipped at the BOTTOM: a third row under OTHER OPTIONS begins exactly at the edge (1 px sliver). Both need verification on the live system; the other seven reports end with empty panel space below their last section and are complete. FONT CAVEAT: in the bold caps section-header font the G is drawn almost like a C at this size, so the headers look like 'OFFICE/CROUP', 'DATE RANCE', 'APPOINTMENT DATE RANCE', 'CROUP BY', 'PACE BREAK BY'; a pixel comparison with real C glyphs (e.g. in CANCELLATION) shows the extra lower-right stroke of a G, so they are transcribed as OFFICE/GROUP, DATE RANGE, APPOINTMENT DATE RANGE, GROUP BY, PAGE BREAK BY. NAMING DIFFERENCES worth keeping: the date section is 'DATE RANGE' on six reports but 'APPOINTMENT DATE RANGE' on Lab Report, SmartAssist Report Card and Lab Cost Report; 'PROVIDER' vs 'PROVIDER/USER' (Appointment Detail only); the first-row selector is titled 'REPORT TYPE' (Lab Report, Lab Cost Report), 'REPORT FORMAT' (SmartAssist Report Card) or 'APPOINTMENT TYPE' (Appointment Detail: Regular / Archived), while on Appointment List 'APPOINTMENT TYPE' is a different section (Length dropdown + Status checkboxes); header 'APPOINT NOW' is two words whereas its checkbox says 'AppointNow'; the balance option is worded 'Include Patient Balance' on Appointment List but 'Show Patient Balance' on Missed Appointments Not Marked As Missed (both ticked by default). Not part of this category's 9 files: the parent folder also holds drop_down_options.PNG (the Reports menu), not transcribed here.

dynamic_rules.when: REPORT FORMAT TO PRINT = Confirmation Call List (the state of our capture)
dynamic_rules.effect: Of the filter criteria only the office (OFFICE/GROUP), PROVIDER, the DATE RANGE dates and Include Patient Balance are enabled. Everything else is greyed - the EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE, EXCLUDE RESP. PARTY TYPE, CANCELLATION REASON and OPERATORY pickers, the Length dropdown, the Status checkboxes Missed / Cancelled, Include Off Call List and all four SORT BY radios (the greyed set recorded in our capture).
dynamic_rules.evidence_quote: With `Confirmation Call List`: only office, provider, dates and `Include Patient Balance` are enabled.

dynamic_rules.when: REPORT FORMAT TO PRINT = Cancelled List
dynamic_rules.effect: EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE, EXCLUDE RESP. PARTY TYPE, CANCELLATION REASON and Include Off Call List become enabled; OPERATORY and the Status checkboxes (Missed / Cancelled) stay disabled and Length appears disabled. The states of SORT BY and Include Patient Balance in this mode are not stated.
dynamic_rules.evidence_quote: With `Cancelled List` selected: `EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE`, `EXCLUDE RESP. PARTY TYPE`, `CANCELLATION REASON`, `Include Off Call List` enabled; `OPERATORY`, `Length`, `Status` disabled.

dynamic_rules.effect: The SELECT picker chooses office groups defined in setup instead of offices; with Office it chooses one or more offices. Cross-cutting statement of the document for the Appointment, Recall and Referral criteria screens - recorded once here (Appointment List); it applies to every report of this category that has the Office / Office Group radios.
dynamic_rules.evidence_quote: `Office` = one or more offices; `Office Group` = groups from setup.

dynamic_rules.when: A favorite has already been saved for the report (the legacy tool keeps one saved version per report)
dynamic_rules.effect: The action button ADD TO MY FAVORITES reads UPDATE MY FAVORITES. Cross-cutting statement of the document for the Appointment, Recall and Referral criteria screens - recorded once here (Appointment List); it applies to every report of this category. Whether the relabel shows only when the screen is opened from My Favorites is not stated.
dynamic_rules.evidence_quote: One saved version per report (`ADD TO MY FAVORITES` → `UPDATE MY FAVORITES`).

corrections.text: The section title that our capture cuts off above the six list-format radios is REPORT FORMAT TO PRINT - it replaces the [?] of the inventory.
corrections.evidence_quote: the header of the six radios is `REPORT FORMAT TO PRINT`

corrections.text: The capture is clipped at the TOP only. The hidden area holds the PRINT FORMAT section (PDF / Excel, see added_controls) and the title REPORT FORMAT TO PRINT of the list-format radios; the document names nothing else there, and the bottom of the panel (SORT BY) is complete in our capture. With PRINT FORMAT added the criteria panel is fully known.
corrections.evidence_quote: The area clipped at the top holds `PRINT FORMAT` (`PDF` / `Excel`) and the header of the six radios is `REPORT FORMAT TO PRINT`.

corrections.text: The fifth radio is confirmed as read: Cancelled From Automated Campaigns (vendor screenshot of May 2024). In June 2023 the same radio was labelled Cancelled From Denticon Patient Engagement - an older-build label of the same option, not a further option.
corrections.evidence_quote: Fifth radio was `Cancelled From Denticon Patient Engagement` in June 2023 and `Cancelled From Automated Campaigns` from May 2024.

corrections.text: Cancelled List and Missed List are history lists - they ignore whether a replacement appointment exists. Call List is the work list: with default parameters it leaves out the appointments that were replaced or taken off the call list.
corrections.evidence_quote: `Cancelled List` and `Missed List` are history; `Call List` is the work list

corrections.text: DATE RANGE (Start Date / End Date) is matched on the appointment date and defaults to today - the 11/21/2026 of our capture is the capture day, not a fixed default.
corrections.evidence_quote: `DATE RANGE` | Appointment date; defaults to today.

corrections.text: CANCELLATION REASON limits the cancelled appointments to the chosen cancellation reasons - the system reasons and the ones the office defined.
corrections.evidence_quote: `CANCELLATION REASON` | Limits cancelled appointments to chosen reasons (system and office-defined).

corrections.text: Cancelled From Automated Campaigns lists the appointments that the patient cancelled through an automated campaign message.
corrections.evidence_quote: Appointments cancelled by the patient through an automated campaign message

corrections.text: Off call list = call-list entries that a user took off the list by ticking Off List (an entry also leaves the call list when it is rescheduled or when a new appointment is made; a removed entry can be restored). What exactly the checkbox adds to each list format is not stated beyond its name.
corrections.evidence_quote: An entry leaves the list when rescheduled, when a new appointment is made, or when a user ticks `Off List`; it can be restored.

corrections.text: Length, the Status checkboxes Missed / Cancelled and Include Off Call List mirror the filters of the Scheduler's Call List screen - Select Duration (mins), Show Missed, Show Cancelled, Show Off Call List. Length is therefore an appointment-duration filter in minutes; its values other than Any are not documented (see unresolved).
corrections.evidence_quote: Mirror the Scheduler `Call List` screen filters `Select Duration (mins)`, `Show Missed`, `Show Cancelled`, `Show Off Call List`

corrections.text: Confirmation Call List is the working list for confirmation calls, for one date or a date range.
corrections.evidence_quote: Working list for confirmation calls for a date or range

corrections.text: Call List is the former menu report Appointment Call List: the missed or cancelled appointments that still have no replacement.
corrections.evidence_quote: `Call List` | old menu name `Appointment Call List` `[P27]` | Missed or cancelled appointments that still have no replacement

corrections.text: Pull Chart List is the former menu report Appointment Pull Chart List: the "patients for the day" list used for pulling charts.
corrections.evidence_quote: `Pull Chart List` | old menu name `Appointment Pull Chart List` `[P27]` | "Patients for the day" list for pulling charts

corrections.text: Cancelled List is the former menu report Appt Cancellation List / Appointment Cancellation List.
corrections.evidence_quote: `Appt Cancellation List` / `Appointment Cancellation List` | `Appointment List` → `Cancelled List`

corrections.text: Missed List is the former menu report Missed Appointment List: the history of the appointments marked missed.
corrections.evidence_quote: `Missed List` | old menu name `Missed Appointment List` `[P27]` | History of appointments marked missed

corrections.text: Vendor guides still call the Cancelled From Automated Campaigns format by its old name, Appointment Cancellation Report From Denticon Patient Communication / Engagement.
corrections.evidence_quote: `Appointment Cancellation Report From Denticon Patient Communication / Engagement` | `Appointment List` → `Cancelled From Automated Campaigns`

corrections.text: Include Patient Balance prints the patient balance on the list - shown as Curr Bal on the Cancelled List and as Bal: on the campaign-cancellation format. (Whether the checkbox is enabled for those two formats is not stated - see unresolved.)
corrections.evidence_quote: `Include Patient Balance` | Prints the balance (`Curr Bal` / `Bal:`).

corrections.text: Hidden population rule with no criteria control: a deleted appointment leaves no trace in any appointment report (it exists only in the Audit Trail) - unlike a cancelled appointment, which is removed from the schedule but kept in the appointment history and on the call list. Category-wide statement, recorded once here (Appointment List); it applies to every report of this category.
corrections.evidence_quote: A **deleted** appointment leaves no trace in any appointment report (only the Audit Trail).
